item.title: Drones will save the world
item.description: Bees drone. They make honey, fly, pollinate, dance, throw up, fuck, sting and drone. We discovered the drone thanks to them, and with them, movement has always been part of the drone. Then we invented air conditioning and the drone stopped moving. To restore the balance and bring movement back, we had to invent mechanical drones as well, and use them to kill people. Flies drone too, but nobody cares because flies aren’t cool.
